description: This file defines the PGVectorDriver class, a specialized driver for interacting with a PostgreSQL vector store, including connection setup, document handling, and query adaptation.

classes.name: PGVectorDriver
classes.description: A driver class for managing vector store operations with PostgreSQL, including connection configuration, document ingestion, and query customization.

methods.name: getPostgresConnectionOptions
methods.description: Asynchronously constructs and returns PostgreSQL connection options, including handling additional configuration and validation.

methods.name: getArgs
methods.description: Prepares and returns arguments required for initializing the PGVectorStore, such as connection options, table name, columns, and distance strategy.

methods.name: instanciate
methods.description: Creates and returns an instance of PGVectorStore, optionally applying metadata filters.

methods.name: fromDocuments
methods.description: Creates a PGVectorStore instance from an array of documents and adds these documents to the store.

methods.name: adaptInstance
methods.description: Modifies a PGVectorStore instance to customize its similarity search and query execution, including connection management and filtering based on metadata.
